description: Defines a ConnectivityMonitor class that provides a simplified connectivity status, always returning online. It manages a broadcast stream indicating connectivity status and provides a getter for the current status.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: A class that monitors and provides connectivity status, currently simulated as always online.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor and setting the connectivity stream to true.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the internal stream controller to clean up resources.
